basic_info.description: 233 Sargent St is a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom turnkey home that offers charm and convenience with breathtaking ocean and city lights views. Located just minutes from San Francisco State, downtown, the airport, and the beach, it's ideal for entertaining or multigenerational living. The entire home is bathed in natural light. Downstairs features a private bedroom with a full bath and a covered walk-out balcony. Upstairs includes two more bedrooms, another full bath, a cozy fireplace in the living room, and a spacious chef's kitchen that opens to the dining area. Interior highlights include gorgeous wood and tile flooring, recessed lighting throughout, huge picture windows, a skylight, newer roof and appliances. Outside, enjoy a serene backyard retreat with a large, covered deck for year-round enjoyment, a patio, and an expansive yard ready for your personal touch. Lovingly maintained by the same family for over 50 years, this rare gem is now available to the public for the first time. If you're considering a move or investment in San Francisco, this one deserves a closer look.
